findings.claim: The accepted review incorrectly rejects the extraction's repeated-parameter counterexample to Lemma 8.10. It imposes the generic GL2 Whittaker support wall and symmetric Schur family on the actual degenerate primed model, which has trivial unipotent character when n=m=2. Both the review's boundary argument and its zero-derivative argument use the wrong function.
findings.evidence: Published AKY p.47, formal-family definition immediately before Lemma 8.10: “Here, we note that Ψ(u) = 1 for u ∈ U′.” For n=m=2, G′=GL2, P′=B′, L′=GL1×GL1, N′=U′, Ψ|N′=1, V′=1, and the displayed family is F_(x1,x2)(a,b)=q^(-(a-b)/2)x1^a x2^b for ALL a,b∈Z. At x1=x2=x≠0, set F=F_(x,x) and H=(a-b)F. The q+1 right cosets of K′diag(varpi,1)K′ give Tf(a,b)=q f(a+1,b)+f(a,b+1); F and H both have eigenvalue 2 sqrt(q)x. The central generator and its inverse act by x² and x^(-2). H(1)=0 but H(diag(varpi,1))=q^(-1/2)x≠0. There is no a≥b support restriction, and F_(xe^t,xe^(-t))=F exp(t(a-b)) has derivative H. The printed equal-parameter spanning set has just F. Publisher PDF read and p.47 rendered on 2026-09-30, SHA256 51bf4f6b80543d4c03c6e9fd68463115cd94e87fc6bf16df3f6289c087e29004; exact symbolic proof and 4374 rational checks are in the report.

findings.claim: The extraction records 19 sourceIssues, including quoted stated results, but lacks the sourceVersions list prescribed by PROTOCOL §18. Version provenance exists elsewhere but is not in the standard collation record.
findings.evidence: PROTOCOL §18 says the file records what was read “alongside sourceIssues” and gives the sourceVersions schema. The result has no such key. Its source/continuation records identify the published Cambridge article and arXiv 2110.09070v4, dates and hashes; the accepted review additionally distinguishes a download-stamped byte hash from normalized text. The unchanged extraction passes check_paper.py, so this is not a claim of a current checker failure or lack of a published reading.
